evidence.claim: Earliest archived recipe revision containing the step is dated 1998-10-05.
evidence.quote: 5. 1 Nov - 31 Mar: add 1.5 kg bentonite anti anti-settling agent (winter dose).

evidence.title: CHANGE REQUEST CR-1998-004
evidence.claim: In 1998, a winter dose of bentonite was added to AF-12 to prevent hard settling caused by cold storage in warehouse M2.
evidence.quote: finished goods are stored in the unheated warehouse M2; cold storage causes hard settling (DR-1998-007)

evidence.title: DEVIATION REPORT DR-1998-007
evidence.claim: In 1998, hard pigment settling occurred in AF-12 tins stored in unheated warehouse M2 during winter, leading to a proposal for more anti-settling agent.
evidence.quote: hard settling of pigment in tins stored in warehouse M2 (unheated). Temperature in M2 down to -6 °C in January.

evidence.title: DEVIATION REPORT DR-1998-007
evidence.claim: In 1998, it was proposed to increase the anti-settling agent for winter production because budget for warehouse heating was unavailable.
evidence.quote: Proposal: increase anti-settling agent for winter production; investigate warehouse heating (budget not available).

evidence.title: Re: M2 usage
evidence.claim: As of 2023, warehouse M2 is no longer used for finished goods, and overflow is stored in a heated external depot.
evidence.quote: M2 has held only empty drums, pallets and packaging since M5 opened in 2011. No finished goods are stored there

evidence.title: Commissioning record EQ-2011-006 - finished goods warehouse M5
evidence.claim: In 2011, finished goods storage moved to the heated warehouse M5, while M2 was relegated to packaging and pallets.
evidence.quote: From 1 November 2011 all finished goods are stored in M5. Warehouse M2 will be used for empty packaging and pallets only.

evidence.title: Commissioning record EQ-2011-006 - finished goods warehouse M5
evidence.claim: In 2011, the new finished goods warehouse M5 passed heating tests, maintaining a minimum internal temperature of 14.5 °C.
evidence.quote: heating test 72 h at -8 °C external, internal 14.5 °C minimum - passed
